brief: Cuts sections out of a list by positions or by start and length, and returns the parts outside a section.
detail: Build one with new stzListSections(aList) or over a stzList object; it keeps its own copy. A section is named by its first and last positions (Section), a range by its start and length (Range, Ranges); an anti-section is whatever lies outside. Positions count from 1; negative ones count from the end, and out-of-range ones are clipped, not refused. Section answers a flat list, Range answers a list wrapped one level deeper. Two aliases, ManyRanges and RangesOtherThan, raise errors today.
